semantics.exact_statement: For a real trace-free symmetric 3 by 3 shear tensor, the characteristic discriminant, normalized shear-shape identity, trace-free Cayley-Hamilton reduction, Krylov/Vandermonde factorization, Krylov Gram identity, and registered 14-coordinate local-chart Jacobian factor hold exactly. A polynomial quotient identity supplies only the invariant chain-rule core of VT-T13.

symbol_type_domain_map.v_j: four typed real three-vectors in one shear eigenframe
symbol_type_domain_map.K: Krylov matrix with columns v_0, sigma v_0, sigma^2 v_0
symbol_type_domain_map.I2: tr(sigma^2), strictly positive where J_sigma is used

frame_signature_units_conventions.action: active Cartesian SO(3); O(3) parity is retained as a separate type
frame_signature_units_conventions.chart: eigenframe slice with one declared cyclic reference vector

assumptions: sigma is real, symmetric, and trace-free
the local-chart theorem is restricted to simple spectrum and a cyclic reference vector
all four vectors share one frame, epoch/window, and perturbative order
I2 is nonzero for normalized shape and quotient-differential identities
positivity_nonzero_conditions: the three eigenvalue differences and three reference-vector eigenframe components are nonzero on the cyclic chart
branches: proper versus improper parity typing without global O(3) reconstruction
exclusions: No global orbit-separation theorem is asserted.
No invariant-ring or degree-completeness theorem is asserted.
No full E_ab, H_ab, pi_ab, A_a, omega_a evolution decomposition is asserted.
No kinematic-to-geometric escalation, native morphology atlas, or Bianchi family identification is asserted.
singular_loci: a repeated eigenvalue or zero reference component makes the Krylov chart noncyclic
enlarged stabilizers are outside the principal local-chart statement
boundary_or_initial_conditions: zero-shear branch is refused for J_sigma

target.canonical_form: Exact integer/rational polynomial identities, factored Krylov and Jacobian determinants, and explicit nonpromotion states.
target.equivalence_relation: exact equality in the declared polynomial/rational function domain
invariants: four-vector moment chart m_{jp}=v0^T sigma^p vj for p=0,1,2
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not read another axis script, derivation, or result before submitting.
Do not infer global separation from a nonzero local Jacobian.
Do not infer completeness from Cayley-Hamilton or finite test vectors.
Do not replace the full VT-T13 source decomposition by the restricted chain-rule core.
Do not treat tool preflight as a theorem verdict.
Do not convert a missing engine or license into an exception or pass.

wolfram_xact.obligation: Independent exact verification in Wolfram Language with xAct loaded and version recorded.

sympy.obligation: Independent exact symbolic verification in SymPy.

sage_singular.obligation: Independent exact verification in SageMath with Singular version recorded.

lean.obligation: Faithful exact polynomial formalization compiled under formal/lean-toolchain.

independence.script_result_ownership: per-axis results are unique and withheld until parent adjudication
independence.correlation_disclosure: The main writer authored the tracked engine programs; blind engine execution is independent evidence, not independent human derivation.

exceptions_adjudication.aggregate_status_rule: R3 requires CAS_4AXIS_PASS; majority vote is forbidden
